The tree and the ground beneath are inseparable from what took place there. This intertwining of space, place, and experience ________. If place and space are central to the very heart of experience, we must accept the possibility that the spatial framework is the medium of all experiences — actions, thoughts, memories, and feelings of every place — not merely a background or context exterior to experience (as commonly supposed).
